conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Cardivel increases side effects compared with Alvenor. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Alvenor.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Maplewood Cardiac Group.
